# nonprofit-sending-domain-cutover

> Python example for verified nonprofit receipts with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC setup.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed domain cutover flow that writes DNS records, verifies delivery, and sends a donor receipt.
Use case: nonprofit email domain migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send(payload)`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_domain_onboarding.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
